hint.text: A compound sentence combines two independent clauses with a comma and a coordinating conjunction.

atoms.a: She has travelled a lot, but she has never been to Mexico.
Scarlet was worried about failing the test.
We could go to the cinema, or we could stay at home.
David is busy with his homework, so I played by myself.
My dad works as a biology teacher in a nearby city.
Raj took a ride on the Ferris wheel, and he ate waffles with whipped cream.

instruction.text: Find the coordinating conjunction in the sentence.

atoms.b: My dog likes getting muddy, ((but)) he hates having a bath.
atoms.sound: My dog likes getting muddy, but he hates having a bath.

instruction.text: Find the coordinating conjunction in the sentence.

atoms.b: I like to read, ((and)) I start a new book every week.
atoms.sound: I like to read, and I start a new book every week.

instruction.text: Find the coordinating conjunction in the sentence.

atoms.b: Aaliyah feels ill, ((so)) she is at the doctor’s.
atoms.sound: Aaliyah feels ill, so she is at the doctor’s.
